title: Hearty Smoky Canadian Cookies Dumplings
description: A smoky and silky Canadian dish featuring cookies and dumplings, perfect for a special occasion, and is halal-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, oats, baking soda, salt, and smoked paprika.
In a separate bowl, mix together the melted butter and brown sugar.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Fold in the crushed chocolate chip cookies.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
While the dumplings are baking, bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan.
Once the dumplings are done, carefully add them to the boiling water and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the dumplings warm, garnished with additional crushed cookies if desired.
